scanNote:
5-UNITNING IKKINCHI BETI (35-bet). Chap yarmi OCH KO'K fonli.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Planning Ahead' va YASHIL yorliqda oq '5'.

CHAP USTUN (och ko'k fonda):
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading' sarlavhasi.
6) 'You are going to read about the ambitions of three young people. For questions 1-6, choose from the people (A-C). Who...' Beshta savol, o'ngda to'q sariq raqamlar va nuqtali joylar (1-6).
Ostida UCHTA TAVSIF, har birida SURAT va gap pufakchasi:
• 'Ito Oshima is a schoolboy from Japan. He is 17 years old.' - och ko'k sviterdagi kulib turgan yapon yigit; yorliq 'A'
• 'Roberto Fellini is a 21-year-old from Italy.' - katakli ko'ylakdagi sariq sochli yigit; yorliq 'B'
• 'Natasha Wilkins is a 16-year-old schoolgirl from Scotland.' - pushti futbolkadagi, qo'lida kitob ushlagan sariq sochli qiz; yorliq 'C'

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development' sarlavhasi.
7) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: complete, training, local, save, wish, meet, get, full-time, entrance, long. Ikki ustunda 10 nuqtali qator.
8) 'Underline the correct word.' To'rtta gap, har birida qalin harfli ikki variant.
9) 'Fill in make or do, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ikki ustunda 10 band.
10) 'Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Yetti ibora bir xatboshida.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the texts again and take notes under these headings, then talk about each person.' Qiya harflarda: Ambition - Reason - Job Qualities - Plans/Fixed Arrangements.
11) a) 'Make as many sentences as possible using the prompts.' Uch ustunli jadval: doctor/taxi driver/policeman/pilot/farmer/builder | has to / doesn't have to | travel a lot / work long hours / work outdoors / wear a uniform / wake up very early / work in the evenings/at weekends. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna.
   b) 'Which of the jobs above would you not like to do? Why?' Ko'k qiya namuna.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '35'.

exercises.instructionEn: The ambitions of three young people.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh TAVSIFNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI bandlarda berilgan.


UCh QAHRAMON:

  A - Ito Oshima, 17 yosh, Yaponiya,
      maktab o'quvchisi
      → o't o'chiruvchi bo'lmoqchi

  B - Roberto Fellini, 21 yosh,
      Italiya
      → barmen bo'lmoqchi

  C - Natasha Wilkins, 16 yosh,
      Shotlandiya, maktab o'quvchisi
      → shifokor bo'lmoqchi

  ⚠ Ular 34-betdagi 5-mashqdagi
  Ito, Roberto va Natasha bilan
  AYNI odamlar.


⚠ MATNLARDAGI KELASI ZAMON ShAKLLARI:

  'I'M GOING TO begin a training
   course' - NIYaT
  "I'M SURE I'LL PASS it" - TAXMIN
  "I'M GETTING a full-time job next
   summer" - ANIQ, kelishilgan reja

  ⚠ Uch shakl - 5-unitning grammatika
  mavzusi (36-betda tushuntiriladi).


⚠ 'AN AMBITION':

  = orzu, maqsad.
  ⚠ 'ambitious' = orzumand,
  intiluvchan.


⚠ 'A 21-YEAR-OLD':

  = 21 yoshli odam.
  ⚠ DEFIS bilan va 'year' BIRLIKDA.
  ⚠ 'a 21-yearS-old' - XATO.
  ⚠ 7-betdagi 5-betdagi kirishda ham
  '200-word text' shunday edi.

points.en: [A] Ito Oshima is a schoolboy from Japan. He is 17 years old.
points.uz: [A] Ito Oshima - Yaponiyalik maktab o'quvchisi. U 17 yoshda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a schoolboy' = maktab o'quvchisi (o'g'il).
⚠ 'He is 17 years old' - yosh 'to be' bilan.

points.en: [A] "I've always wanted to be a firefighter because I want to save lives. Firefighters have to be brave and strong, as their work is often dangerous."
points.uz: [A] "Men doim o't o'chiruvchi bo'lishni xohlaganman, chunki hayot saqlab qolishni istayman. O't o'chiruvchilar jasur va kuchli bo'lishi kerak, chunki ularning ishi ko'pincha xavfli".
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I've always wanted" - PRESENT PERFECT
(7-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'have to be' - 34-betdagi 3-mashq qolipi.
⚠ 'as' bu yerda = chunki.

points.en: [A] "I work out twice a week at the local gym because I want to be ready for the entrance test. I'm sure I'll pass it."
points.uz: [A] "Kirish testiga tayyor bo'lish uchun haftada ikki marta mahalliy sport zalida mashq qilaman. Ishonchim komil, uni topshiraman".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to work out' = sport bilan shug'ullanmoq.
⚠ 'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta.
⚠ 'ready FOR' - predlog 'for' (10-mashqda).
⚠ "I'll pass" - TAXMIN (will).

points.en: [A] "After the test, in September, I'm going to begin a firefighting training course. I know the course isn't going to be easy, but I'm going to work really hard. I hope I'll pass it, so wish me luck!"
points.uz: [A] "Testdan keyin, sentyabrda, o't o'chirish bo'yicha o'quv kursini boshlayman. Bilaman, kurs oson bo'lmaydi, lekin juda qattiq ishlayman. Uni topshiraman deb umid qilaman, omad tilang!"
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'm going to" - NIYaT (uch marta).
⚠ 'IN September' - oy oldidan 'in' (10-mashqda).
⚠ 'a training course' - 7-mashqda.
⚠ 'wish me luck' - 7-mashqda.

points.en: [B] Roberto Fellini is a 21-year-old from Italy.
[B] "I want to work as a barman because I like meeting people. A good barman has to be friendly and patient."
points.uz: [B] "Barmen bo'lib ishlashni xohlayman, chunki odamlar bilan tanishishni yoqtiraman. Yaxshi barmen samimiy va sabrli bo'lishi kerak".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to work AS a barman' - 'as' ShART
(10-mashqda).
⚠ 'friendly and patient' - 34-betdagi 3-mashq
sifatlari.

points.en: [B] "This won't be a problem for me, as I love socialising and I never get angry."
points.uz: [B] "Bu men uchun muammo bo'lmaydi, chunki men odamlar bilan aralashishni yaxshi ko'raman va hech qachon jahlim chiqmaydi".
points.noteUz:
⚠ "won't" = 'will not' - kelajak haqida taxmin.
⚠ 'to get angry' = jahli chiqmoq (7-mashqda).
⚠ 'to socialise' - 34-betdagi 2-mashqda.

points.en: [B] "I recently finished a bartending course in Rome and I'm very excited at the moment, as I'm getting a full-time job in my uncle's bar next summer."
points.uz: [B] "Yaqinda Rimda barmenlik kursini tugatdim va hozir juda hayajondaman, chunki kelasi yozda amakimning barida to'liq stavkali ish olaman".
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'M GETTING a full-time job NEXT SUMMER" -
PRESENT CONTINUOUS kelasi zamon ma'nosida:
ANIQ, kelishilgan reja.
⚠ 'a full-time job' - 7-mashqda.
⚠ 'IN Rome', 'IN my uncle's bar' - 10-mashqda.

points.en: [C] Natasha Wilkins is a 16-year-old schoolgirl from Scotland.
points.uz: [C] Natasha Wilkins - Shotlandiyalik 16 yoshli maktab o'quvchisi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a schoolgirl' = maktab o'quvchisi (qiz).
⚠ 'a 16-year-old schoolgirl' - sifat vazifasida,
DEFIS bilan.

points.en: [C] "I'd like to work as a doctor because I like helping sick people. It's not an easy job though, as doctors have to be hardworking and careful."
points.uz: [C] "Shifokor bo'lib ishlashni xohlardim, chunki kasal odamlarga yordam berishni yoqtiraman. Lekin bu oson ish emas, chunki shifokorlar mehnatkash va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak".
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'd like to" = 'I would like to' - MULOYIM.
⚠ 'though' gap o'rtasida = 'lekin'.
⚠ 'hardworking and careful' - 34-betdagi
3-mashq sifatlari.

points.en: [C] "They often work very long hours and they can't make mistakes."
points.uz: [C] "Ular ko'pincha juda uzoq ishlaydi va xato qilishga haqqi yo'q".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to work long hours' - 7-mashqda.
⚠ 'to MAKE mistakes' - 'to do' EMAS (9-mashqda).
⚠ "can't" bu yerda = imkoni yo'q, mumkin emas.

points.en: [C] "When I finish my A levels, I'm going to study Medicine at university. I just hope I'll be a good doctor."
points.uz: [C] "A-daraja imtihonlarini tugatgach, universitetda tibbiyotni o'qiyman. Faqat yaxshi shifokor bo'laman deb umid qilaman".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'A levels' - Britaniyada 18 yoshda
topshiriladigan yakuniy maktab imtihonlari.
⚠ 'to study Medicine AT university' - 10-mashqda;
'university' ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'When I FINISH ...' - vaqt ergash gapida
PRESENT SIMPLE (5-unit mavzusi).

exercises.instructionEn: You are going to read about the ambitions of three young people. For questions 1-6, choose from the people (A-C). Who...
exercises.instructionUz: Uch yoshning orzulari haqida o'qiysiz. 1-6 savollar uchun odamlardan (A-C) tanlang. Kim...
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SAVOL, UCh ODAM.

  ⚠ Birinchi savolda IKKI javob bor
  (1 va 2) - chunki IKKI kishi hamon
  maktabda o'qiydi.


JAVOBLAR:

  1, 2  is still at school? → A va C
     ⚠ Ito - 'a schoolboy';
     Natasha - 'a schoolgirl'.

  3  is going to study Medicine? → C
     ⚠ Natasha: "I'm going to study
     Medicine at university".

  4  exercises regularly? → A
     ⚠ Ito: 'I work out TWICE A WEEK'.

  5  has just completed a course? → B
     ⚠ Roberto: 'I RECENTLY FINISHED a
     bartending course'.

  6  has already arranged a job for
     next summer? → B
     ⚠ Roberto: "I'M GETTING a full-time
     job in my uncle's bar NEXT SUMMER".


⚠ 'STILL' va 'ALREADY':

  still = hamon, hali ham
  already = allaqachon

  ⚠ Savollarda ikkalasi ham bor.


⚠ 'TO ARRANGE':

  = kelishmoq, tashkil qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'a fixed arrangement' = kelishilgan
  reja - Speaking bo'limida ham bor.


⚠ BUNDAY MAShQNI QANDAY BAJARISh:

  1) Avval SAVOLLARNI o'qing
  2) Har savolning KALIT so'zini
     belgilang ('still at school',
     'Medicine', 'exercises', 'completed',
     'arranged')
  3) Keyin matnlarni o'qib, kalit
     so'zning MA'NODOShINI qidiring

  ⚠ Matnda AYNAN o'sha so'z bo'lmasligi
  mumkin: 'exercises regularly' →
  matnda 'I work out twice a week'.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ IKKI javob: Ito - 'a schoolBOY',
Natasha - 'a schoolGIRL'.
⚠ Roberto 21 yoshda va kursni tugatgan.

pairs.left: 3  Who is going to study Medicine?
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Natasha: "I'm going to STUDY MEDICINE at
university".
⚠ 'Medicine' - fan nomi, KATTA harf, artiklsiz.

⚠ Ito: 'I WORK OUT TWICE A WEEK at the local
gym'.
⚠ 'to work out' = sport bilan shug'ullanmoq -
'exercise' ning ma'nodoshi.

pairs.left: 5  Who has just completed a course?
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Roberto: 'I RECENTLY FINISHED a bartending
course in Rome'.
⚠ 'recently finished' = 'has just completed'.

pairs.left: 6  Who has already arranged a job for next summer?
pairs.leftUz: Kim kelasi yoz uchun ishni allaqachon kelishib qo'ygan?
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Roberto: "I'M GETTING a full-time job in my
uncle's bar NEXT SUMMER".
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ANIQ, kelishilgan reja.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MATNLARDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to SAVE lives      - hayot saqlab
                       qolmoq
  the LOCAL gym      - mahalliy sport
                       zali
  a(n) ENTRANCE test - kirish testi
  a(n) TRAINING course - o'quv kursi
  WISH me luck       - omad tilang
  to MEET people     - odamlar bilan
                       tanishmoq
  to GET angry       - jahli chiqmoq
  a(n) FULL-TIME job - to'liq stavkali
                       ish
  to work LONG hours - uzoq ishlamoq
  to COMPLETE a course - kursni tugatmoq


⚠ 'A(N)' BELGISI:

  3, 4, 8-bandlarda 'a(n)' bor - demak
  keyingi so'z UNLI bilan boshlanishi
  ham mumkin:
     AN entrance test (e - unli)
     A training course (t - undosh)
     A full-time job (f - undosh)


⚠ 'FULL-TIME' va 'PART-TIME':

  full-time = to'liq stavka (haftasiga
     ~40 soat)
  part-time = yarim stavka

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan, chunki SIFAT
  vazifasida.


⚠ 'TO GET' + SIFAT:

  'to get angry' = jahli chiqmoq
  ⚠ 'get' + sifat = HOLAT O'ZGARIShI:
     get tired, get ready, get married,
     get dressed, get better

  ⚠ 29-betdagi 18-mashqda 'get dressed'
  bor edi.


⚠ 'TO WISH SB LUCK':

  = omad tilamoq.
  ⚠ 'luck' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
  ⚠ 'Good luck!' - eng keng tarqalgan
  shakl.


⚠ 'AN ENTRANCE':

  = kirish (joy yoki imtihon).
  ⚠ 'to enter' = kirmoq (PREDLOGSIZ).
  ⚠ 'an entrance test/exam' = kirish
  imtihoni.


⚠ 'TO COMPLETE' va 'TO FINISH':

  Ikkalasi ham 'tugatmoq', lekin
  'complete' RASMIYROQ va 'to'liq
  bajarmoq' ma'nosini beradi.

YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.


⚠ 'TO TAKE' va 'TO PASS' A TEST:

  to TAKE a test = testni TOPShIRMOQ
     (jarayon)
  to PASS a test = testdan O'TMOQ
     (natija)
  to FAIL a test = testdan yiqilmoq

  ⚠ 1-gapda 'because he WORKED HARD' -
  demak NATIJA yaxshi → 'PASSED'.


⚠ 'TO LEARN' va 'TO STUDY':

  to learn = o'rganmoq (natija:
     bilim olmoq)
  to study = o'qimoq (jarayon:
     universitetda, maktabda)

  ⚠ Universitetdagi fan uchun HAR DOIM
  'study': 'She STUDIES Architecture
  AT university'.


⚠ 'A JOB' va 'WORK':

  a job = SANALADIGAN ot (aniq ish
     joyi)
     'I have a good job.'
  work = SANALMAYDIGAN ot (umuman ish)
     'He does good work.'

  ⚠ 'a good work' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'to do work' - 'to make' EMAS.

  ⚠ 27-betdagi 7-mashqda ham 'work' va
  'task' farqi tushuntirilgan edi.


⚠ 'SICK' va 'ILL':

  ⚠ Britaniyada:
     'ill' - OTDAN OLDIN TURMAYDI
        ('He is ill.' ✓,
         'an ill man' ✗)
     'sick' - otdan oldin turadi
        ('sick people' ✓)

  ⚠ 4-gapda 'sick PEOPLE' - ot bor,
  shuning uchun 'SICK'.

  ⚠ AQShda 'sick' ikkala holatda ham
  ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'to be sick' Britaniyada yana
  'qusmoq' ma'nosida ham bo'ladi.


⚠ 'ARCHITECTURE':

  = me'morchilik.
  ⚠ 'ch' bu yerda /k/ deb o'qiladi:
  /ˈɑːkɪtektʃə/.
  ⚠ Fan nomi - KATTA harf bilan.

items.textEn: 1  He ___ the test because he worked hard.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'because he WORKED HARD' - demak NATIJA
yaxshi → 'PASSED' (testdan o'tdi).
⚠ 'to take a test' - shunchaki topshirmoq
(natija noma'lum).

⚠ Universitetdagi fan uchun HAR DOIM 'STUDY'.
⚠ 'to learn' = o'rganmoq (natija).
⚠ 'Architecture' - 'ch' /k/ deb o'qiladi.

⚠ 'work' - SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'good work' (artiklsiz).
⚠ 'a good job' bo'lardi, lekin bu yerda artikl
YO'Q → 'work'.
⚠ 'to DO work' - 'to make' EMAS.

⚠ Britaniyada 'ill' OTDAN OLDIN TURMAYDI.
⚠ 'sick PEOPLE' - ot bor, shuning uchun 'SICK'.
⚠ 'He is ill' ✓ lekin 'an ill man' ✗.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in make or do, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: make yoki do ni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
'MAKE' va 'DO' - ENG QIYIN JUFTLIK.


⚠ UMUMIY QOIDA:

  MAKE = biror narsa YARATISh,
     HOSIL QILISh
     make a cake, make a noise,
     make a mistake, make a phone call

  DO = ISh, VAZIFA, YUMUSh bajarish
     do homework, do the washing-up,
     do the shopping, do your best

  ⚠ Lekin qoida MUTLAQ EMAS - ko'p
  ibora YoDLANADI.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  MAKE:
     make mistakes    - xato qilmoq
     make a phone call - qo'ng'iroq
                        qilmoq
     make the beds    - to'shak yig'moq
     make a cup of coffee - qahva
                        tayyorlamoq
     make a noise     - shovqin qilmoq

  DO:
     do my homework   - uy vazifasini
                        bajarmoq
     do the washing-up - idish yuvmoq
     do the shopping  - xarid qilmoq
     do the ironing   - dazmol qilmoq
     do my best       - qo'lidan kelganini
                        qilmoq


⚠ DIQQAT - 'MAKE THE BEDS':

  ⚠ 'to MAKE the bed' = to'shakni
  yig'moq/solmoq.
  ⚠ 'to do the bed' - XATO.
  ⚠ 14-betdagi 13-mashqda va 17-betdagi
  maqolda ham bor edi.


⚠ UY YUMUShLARI - HAMMASI 'DO':

  do the washing-up, do the shopping,
  do the ironing, do the housework,
  do the cleaning

  ⚠ 12-betdagi 1a mashqida o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'TO DO ONE'S BEST':

  = qo'lidan kelganini qilmoq.
  ⚠ "I'll do my best." - juda ko'p
  ishlatiladigan ibora.


⚠ 'TO MAKE A NOISE':

  = shovqin qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'noise' - SANALMAYDIGAN ham,
  sanaladigan ham bo'ladi.
  ⚠ 33-betdagi 9-mashqda 'a strange
  noise' bor edi.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to MAKE a mistake' - 'to do' EMAS.
⚠ Matnda ham bor edi: "they CAN'T MAKE
MISTAKES".

⚠ 'to MAKE a phone call' - qo'ng'iroqni
YaRATASIZ.
⚠ 'to do a call' - XATO.

⚠ 'to DO homework' - VAZIFA bajariladi.
⚠ 'to make homework' - XATO.
⚠ 12-betdagi 1a mashqida o'rganilgan.

⚠ ISTISNO: uy yumushi bo'lsa ham 'MAKE'!
⚠ 'to make the bed' = to'shakni solmoq/yig'moq.
⚠ 17-betdagi maqolda ham bor edi.

⚠ Uy yumushi → 'DO'.
⚠ 'the washing-up' = IDISh yuvish
('the washing' = KIR yuvish - ADAShTIRMANG).

⚠ Biror narsa YaRATISh → 'MAKE'.
⚠ 'to make coffee/tea/a cake' - hammasi 'make'.

⚠ Tovush HOSIL QILINADI → 'MAKE'.
⚠ 'Don't make a noise!' = shovqin qilmang!

⚠ Uy yumushi → 'DO'.
⚠ 'to DO the shopping' (xarid qilish) va
'to GO shopping' (do'konga borish) - biroz
boshqa ma'no.

⚠ Uy yumushi → 'DO'.
⚠ 'iron' da 'r' O'QILMAYDI: /ˈaɪən/.

⚠ 'to DO one's best' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ "I'll do my best" - juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predloglarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI MATNLARDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to be ready FOR a test
     = testga tayyor bo'lmoq
  IN September
     = sentyabrda
  to work AS a barman
     = barmen bo'lib ishlamoq
  IN Rome
     = Rimda
  AT the moment
     = ayni damda
  to get a job IN my uncle's bar
     = amakimning barida ish topmoq
  to study Medicine AT university
     = universitetda tibbiyot o'qimoq


⚠ 'AS' - KASB OLDIDAN:

  'to work AS a barman'
  ⚠ 'to work LIKE a barman' - boshqa
  ma'no: 'barmenga o'xshab ishlamoq'
  (lekin barmen emas).

  ⚠ 16-betdagi matnda ham bor edi:
  'I used to work AS A cleaner'.


⚠ 'AT UNIVERSITY' - ARTIKLSIZ:

  'to study AT university'
  ⚠ Britaniyada artikl YO'Q, chunki
  MAQSAD ko'zda tutilyapti (o'qish).
  ⚠ AQShda 'at THE university'.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'at school',
  'at work', 'in hospital',
  'in prison'.


⚠ 'IN' va 'AT' - JOY UChUN:

  IN Rome (shahar - katta joy)
  IN my uncle's bar (ichida)
  AT university (muassasa - MAQSAD)

  ⚠ 'AT the bar' ham mumkin, lekin
  u 'peshtaxta oldida' ma'nosini
  beradi.


⚠ 'AT THE MOMENT':

  = ayni damda.
  ⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi
  (10-betdagi grammatika).


⚠ 'READY FOR' va 'READY TO':

  ready FOR + OT: 'ready for a test'
  ready TO + FE'L: 'ready to start'

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'ready FOR' + OT.
⚠ 'ready TO' + FE'L: 'ready to start'.

⚠ OY oldidan 'IN'.
⚠ Kun oldidan 'ON'; aniq soat oldidan 'AT'.

⚠ KASB oldidan 'AS'.
⚠ 'work LIKE a barman' = barmenga o'xshab
ishlamoq (lekin barmen emas) - BOShQA ma'no.

⚠ ShAHAR oldidan 'IN'.
⚠ Aniq manzil oldidan 'AT': 'at 5 Green Street'.

⚠ 'AT the moment' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi.

items.textEn: 6  to get a job ___ my uncle's bar
items.whyUz:
⚠ Bino IChIDA ishlash → 'IN'.
⚠ "my uncle's" - egalik apostrofi.

⚠ 'AT university' - ARTIKLSIZ (Britaniya).
⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'at school', 'at work',
'in hospital'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts again and take notes under these headings, then talk about each person. Ambition - Reason - Job Qualities - Plans/Fixed Arrangements
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni qayta o'qing va shu sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling, so'ng har bir odam haqida gapiring. Orzu - Sabab - Kasb xislatlari - Rejalar/Kelishilgan ishlar
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SARLAVHA - HAR ODAM UChUN.


⚠ 'PLANS' va 'FIXED ARRANGEMENTS'
FARQI:

  a plan = NIYaT ('be going to')
     "I'm GOING TO begin a course."
  a fixed arrangement = KELIShILGAN
     ish (present continuous)
     "I'M GETTING a job next summer."

  ⚠ Bu farq 36-betdagi grammatikada
  batafsil tushuntiriladi.


⚠ QAYD OLIShDA TO'LIQ GAP YoZMANG:

  ✓ Ito - firefighter - save lives
  ✗ 'Ito wants to be a firefighter.'

  ⚠ Qayd qancha qisqa bo'lsa,
  gapirganda shuncha erkin bo'lasiz.


⚠ GAPIRISh QOLIPI:

  '[Ism] wants to be a [kasb] because
   [sabab]. [Kasb]s have to be
   [sifatlar]. He/She is going to
   [reja].'

points.en: ITO - Ambition: to be a firefighter. Reason: he wants to save lives. Job Qualities: brave and strong. Plans: he's going to begin a firefighting training course in September.
points.uz: ITO - Orzu: o't o'chiruvchi bo'lish. Sabab: hayot saqlab qolishni xohlaydi. Kasb xislatlari: jasur va kuchli. Rejalar: sentyabrda o't o'chirish kursini boshlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'm going to" - NIYaT (reja).
⚠ 'IN September' - oy oldidan 'in'.

points.en: ITO - Fixed Arrangements: he takes the entrance test after his training. He works out twice a week at the local gym.
points.uz: ITO - Kelishilgan ishlar: mashg'ulotdan keyin kirish testini topshiradi. Haftada ikki marta mahalliy sport zalida mashq qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to work out' = sport bilan shug'ullanmoq.
⚠ 'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta.

points.en: ROBERTO - Ambition: to work as a barman. Reason: he likes meeting people. Job Qualities: friendly and patient.
points.uz: ROBERTO - Orzu: barmen bo'lib ishlash. Sabab: odamlar bilan tanishishni yoqtiradi. Kasb xislatlari: samimiy va sabrli.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to work AS a barman' - 'as' ShART.
⚠ 'like' dan keyin -ING shakli.

points.en: ROBERTO - Fixed Arrangements: he's getting a full-time job in his uncle's bar next summer. He has recently finished a bartending course in Rome.
points.uz: ROBERTO - Kelishilgan ishlar: kelasi yozda amakisining barida to'liq stavkali ish oladi. Yaqinda Rimda barmenlik kursini tugatgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'M GETTING" - PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
ANIQ, KELIShILGAN reja.
⚠ Bu - 'a fixed arrangement' ning aynan misoli.

points.en: NATASHA - Ambition: to work as a doctor. Reason: she likes helping sick people. Job Qualities: hardworking and careful.
points.uz: NATASHA - Orzu: shifokor bo'lib ishlash. Sabab: kasal odamlarga yordam berishni yoqtiradi. Kasb xislatlari: mehnatkash va ehtiyotkor.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'sick people' - 8-mashqda 'sick/ill' farqi
tushuntirilgan.
⚠ 'hardworking and careful' - 34-betdagi
3-mashq sifatlari.

points.en: NATASHA - Plans: when she finishes her A levels, she's going to study Medicine at university.
points.uz: NATASHA - Rejalar: A-daraja imtihonlarini tugatgach, universitetda tibbiyotni o'qiydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'When I FINISH ...' - vaqt ergash gapida
PRESENT SIMPLE, kelasi zamon EMAS.
⚠ 'AT university' - ARTIKLSIZ.

exercises.instructionEn: Make as many sentences as possible using the prompts.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib imkon qadar ko'p gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
'HAVE TO' va 'DOESN'T HAVE TO'.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'A doctor HAS TO work long hours.'
  "A doctor DOESN'T HAVE TO travel a
   lot."


⚠ 'HAVE TO' - ZARURAT:

  'has to' - he/she/it bilan
  'have to' - I/you/we/they bilan

  ⚠ INKOR: "doesn't have to" /
  "don't have to" = ShART EMAS
  (taqiq EMAS!).

  ⚠ "mustn't" esa TAQIQ:
  "You mustn't smoke here." =
  chekish MUMKIN EMAS.

  ⚠ Bu farq juda muhim va 10-unitda
  batafsil o'rganiladi.


JADVAL:

  KASBLAR: doctor, taxi driver,
     policeman, pilot, farmer, builder

  IShLAR:
     travel a lot - ko'p sayohat qilmoq
     work long hours - uzoq ishlamoq
     work outdoors - ochiq havoda
        ishlamoq
     wear a uniform - forma kiymoq
     wake up very early - juda erta
        turmoq
     work in the evenings/at weekends -
        kechqurun/dam olish kunlari
        ishlamoq


⚠ 'OUTDOORS':

  = ochiq havoda.
  ⚠ 9-betdagi xatda 'the outdoors' (ot)
  bor edi; bu yerda RAVISh.
  ⚠ Aksi: 'indoors' = ichkarida.


⚠ 'A UNIFORM':

  ⚠ 'A uniform' - 'AN' EMAS!
  Chunki 'u' bu yerda /juː/ deb
  o'qiladi (undosh tovush kabi).
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'a university',
  'a European country'.


⚠ 'AT WEEKENDS':

  Britaniyada 'AT weekends',
  AQShda 'ON weekends'.
exercises.exampleEn: A doctor has to work long hours. A doctor doesn't have to travel a lot.
exercises.exampleUz: Shifokor uzoq ishlashi kerak. Shifokor ko'p sayohat qilishi shart emas.
modelAnswers: A doctor has to work long hours.
A doctor doesn't have to travel a lot.
A taxi driver has to work in the evenings and at weekends.
A taxi driver doesn't have to wear a uniform.
A policeman has to wear a uniform.
A pilot has to travel a lot.
A pilot doesn't have to work outdoors.
A farmer has to wake up very early and work outdoors.
A farmer doesn't have to wear a uniform.
A builder has to work outdoors and wake up very early.
modelAnswersUz: Shifokor ko'p sayohat qilishi shart emas.
Taksi haydovchisi kechqurun va dam olish kunlari ishlashi kerak.
Taksi haydovchisi forma kiyishi shart emas.
Uchuvchi ochiq havoda ishlashi shart emas.
Dehqon juda erta turishi va ochiq havoda ishlashi kerak.
Quruvchi ochiq havoda ishlashi va juda erta turishi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the jobs above would you not like to do? Why?
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi kasblardan qaysi birini qilishni xohlamas edingiz? Nima uchun?
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  "I WOULDN'T LIKE to work as a pilot
   BECAUSE I don't like travelling a
   lot."


⚠ QOLIP:

  I wouldn't like to work as a [kasb]
  because I don't like [-ING].


⚠ "WOULDN'T LIKE":

  = xohlamas edim.
  ⚠ "I don't want" dan ancha MULOYIM.
  ⚠ 'would' - shartli mayl, fikrni
  yumshatadi.


⚠ 'BECAUSE' + GAP:

  ⚠ 'because' dan keyin TO'LIQ GAP
  keladi (ega + kesim).
  ⚠ 'because of' dan keyin esa OT:
  'because of the rain'.


⚠ 'DON'T LIKE' + -ING:

  "I don't like travelLING a lot."
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'travelLING' (ikki 'l').
  ⚠ 12-betdagi 2-mashqda o'rganilgan.

items.en: Which of the jobs above would you not like to do? Why?
items.uz: Yuqoridagi kasblardan qaysi birini qilishni xohlamas edingiz? Nima uchun?

items.answerUz: Uchuvchi bo'lib ishlashni xohlamas edim, chunki ko'p sayohat qilishni yoqtirmayman.

items.answerEn: No, I wouldn't. I don't like waking up very early.

items.answerEn: No, I wouldn't, because taxi drivers have to work in the evenings and at weekends.
items.answerUz: Yo'q, chunki taksi haydovchilari kechqurun va dam olish kunlari ishlashi kerak.

items.en: Which job would you like to do most?
items.uz: Qaysi ishni eng ko'p qilishni xohlaysiz?
items.answerEn: I'd like to be a doctor, because I like helping sick people.
items.answerUz: Shifokor bo'lishni xohlardim, chunki kasal odamlarga yordam berishni yoqtiraman.

patterns.formula: I've always wanted to be a [kasb] because I want to [sabab].
patterns.exampleEn: I've always wanted to be a firefighter because I want to save lives.
patterns.exampleUz: Men doim o't o'chiruvchi bo'lishni xohlaganman, chunki hayot saqlab qolishni istayman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I've always wanted" - PRESENT PERFECT.
⚠ 'because' - SABAB bog'lovchisi.

patterns.formula: A [kasb] has to [fe'l]. A [kasb] doesn't have to [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: A doctor has to work long hours. A doctor doesn't have to travel a lot.
patterns.exampleUz: Shifokor uzoq ishlashi kerak. Shifokor ko'p sayohat qilishi shart emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "doesn't have to" = ShART EMAS (taqiq EMAS!).
⚠ "mustn't" esa TAQIQ - butunlay boshqa ma'no.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm going to begin a training course in September.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'be going to' - oldindan o'ylangan NIYaT.
⚠ 'IN September' - oy oldidan 'in'.

patterns.formula: I'm getting a job in [joy] next [vaqt].
patterns.exampleEn: I'm getting a full-time job in my uncle's bar next summer.
patterns.exampleUz: Kelasi yozda amakimning barida to'liq stavkali ish olaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ANIQ, KELIShILGAN reja
('a fixed arrangement').

patterns.formula: I wouldn't like to work as a [kasb] because I don't like [-ING].
patterns.exampleEn: I wouldn't like to work as a pilot because I don't like travelling a lot.
patterns.exampleUz: Uchuvchi bo'lib ishlashni xohlamas edim, chunki ko'p sayohat qilishni yoqtirmayman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "wouldn't like" - "don't want" dan MULOYIM.
⚠ 'like' dan keyin -ING shakli.
